description:
The latest sales of a collection, or of one NFT when token_id is
set, newest first: each with its price in its currency and in USD at
the time of the sale, the marketplace, when it sold, the NFT, the
seller and buyer, the transaction hash and gondi_url, the NFT's page.
A summary counts the sales of the period and gives the min, median and
max USD price of those listed. Answers "what did X sell for recently?"
and "what did this NFT last sell for?". A collection's sales include
its wrapped versions', as its GONDI page does. It takes a collection
slug and a token id: when you have a name, call search_gondi first and
take them from its result.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

period.description: Only the sales of this last stretch; every sale if unset.
period.title: Period

token_id.description: Only this NFT's sales: its token id, as a decimal string.
token_id.title: Token Id

name: list_recent_sales

amount_usd.description: At the rate of the sale's time; null when none was recorded.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

collection_slug.description: The collection the NFT is in, which can be a wrapper of the one asked for.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

marketplace.description: Where the order or sale lives; GONDI for GONDI's own.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

SalesSummary.description:
The count covers every sale of the period; the prices only the sales
listed, which are all of them when `sale_count` equals
`listed_sale_count`, else the latest.

min_usd.description: Null when no listed sale has one.
min_usd.title: Min Usd

SalesSummary.title: SalesSummary

sales.description: Newest first; empty when nothing sold in the period.
sales.title: Sales

title: Recent sales
